breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly follows the flawed arithmetic-mean-area approximation, computing A_mean = 325 mm² and stating 'treat it as exact for the deformation calculation,' producing δ ≈ 0.1477 mm as the primary answer. The ground truth removes this approximation entirely and requires the exact integral to be evaluated directly. Although the agent appends a note with the exact integral result (0.1504 mm), the primary specification still repeats the original error of replacing 1/A(x) with 1/A_mean and calling it exact.
